caption: A gym coaching business had 15 clients when the world shut down. Eleven months later it had 189. The ads were not the hard part. Swipe for the three systems.

slides.headline: 15 to 189 clients in 11 months. During COVID.
The problem was never attention.
slides.body: Demand exploded overnight. The problem was not breaking under the weight of it.

slides.headline: Most installs build acquisition first.
slides.body: This one could not afford that order. Fulfillment had to scale at the same speed as demand.

slides.headline: What went in, all at once
items: Client experience: check-ins, community, retention loops

slides.headline: Daily standups through the spike.
slides.body: Weekly KPI review. Four coaches recruited while the client count multiplied.

slides.label: generated in 11 months. No quality crash. No retention crater.

slides.headline: A system that survives that kind of scale-up survives whatever comes next.
